purpose: Documents capabilities whose standalone implementation is a governed prompt-orchestration contract rather than a standalone script entrypoint. The parity comparator accepts this only for named capabilities that still have registry/provider coverage.

capabilities.backlog: Backlog routing is an operator workflow over reports/backlog artifacts.
capabilities.causal-backtrack: Backtracking is a governed diagnostic workflow using healing/dependency helpers rather than a single public CLI.
capabilities.commit: Commit is an operator workflow guarded by registry, path, provenance, and hook checks.
capabilities.coverage-reconcile: Coverage reconciliation is an analysis workflow over knowledge and content dispositions.
capabilities.cross-platform: Cross-platform verification is orchestrated over content, knowledge, and audit helpers.
capabilities.faq-generate: FAQ generation is a content-generation workflow requiring knowledge and evidence gates.
capabilities.heal-page: Page healing is an orchestrated workflow over evaluation, remediation, evidence, and verification.
capabilities.knowledge-diff: Knowledge diff is an orchestration workflow over clone-cache and knowledge artifacts.
capabilities.locale-patch: Locale patching is a governed content-propagation workflow rather than a single script.
capabilities.page-enhance: Page enhancement is a governed content workflow over rubric, evidence, and validation helpers.
capabilities.page-update: Page update is a governed content workflow over stale knowledge, evidence, and validation helpers.
capabilities.plan-normalize: Plan normalization is a governance workflow for reviewing and correcting mixed-context plans.
capabilities.project-phase-store: Project phase tracking is a skill-level workflow around plan/state artifacts.
capabilities.publish-readiness-review: Readiness review is a governed inspection workflow replacing human-review dead ends.
capabilities.refresh-product-page: Product page refresh is a governed workflow over generation, no-downgrade, and verification.
capabilities.section-enhance: Section enhancement is a read-only proposal workflow over content, knowledge, and reports.
capabilities.session-start: Session start is an operator bootstrap workflow over governance and environment checks.
capabilities.stale-detect: Stale detection is an analysis workflow over knowledge diffs and content references.
capabilities.truth-audit-content: Truth audit content is a line-level inspection workflow over content units and knowledge evidence.
